coordinates: Unity world, metres, y up, +z north (sea), +x east
fishMotionNote: FishMotion.Step/PickWanderTarget only ask IWaterBounds.Contains (SwimVolumeBounds = the SwimVolume box); no Physics query, so slabs/platform inside the box are not obstacles. Kept that way (no runtime physics); homes are placed so the whole wander set (|offset| <= r, |offset.y| <= r/2, convex, contains home) clears scenery. Flee (FleeSpeed, unbounded distance) is bounded by the same box only.
notMeasured: network latency / 1-2-4 process timing: the escape sim is the host FixedUpdate rule replayed in EditMode
CurrentDrift: the escape sim uses zero current (CrewEnvironmentRules drift adds to swim velocity in game)
camera pitch: 'up' is the jump/ascend axis only; a player pitching the camera changes the input mix
fish flee paths: only the wander envelope and a 300 s wander simulation per fish are measured
Dock_Town underside: measured as infoPocket only; no escape run and no fill (outside this task)
fish visuals: body radius is the conservative renderer half-extent, not the mesh hull
